fact: The eLand platform, built on CRPRS, is stated to be in use in the Ethiopian cities of Bishoftu, Adama and Shagar for digital land registration, transfers and title records.

The eLand platform states citizens can submit online applications for ownership transfer, lease, mortgage and parcel subdivision, search property with map integration, pay fees online and download title certificates.

fact: INSA says it developed a modernized cadastral registry system for land administration that replaces map-heavy verification with digital landholding records and is already in use in government agencies.

Addis Fortune reports the digitisation of more than 700,000 land titles in Addis Ababa was completed weeks before March 2024 and the service was due to open for public use that month, while a USD 30 million Korea Exim-financed pilot began in four other cities.

fact: AMECO reports that Ethiopia's urban ministry and INSA signed an agreement to launch a digital land registry, deploying 2D and 3D cadastral mapping and expanding e-Land services.
Finland's Ministry for Foreign Affairs says land certificates had been issued for 34 million parcels in 562 woredas by the end of June 2026 through Ethiopia's digital land registry.
The Ethiopian News Agency reports NRLAIS has been operational in 450 woredas, digitising and standardising rural land records, and has certified some 30 million land parcels.
